crossRefs.note: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
When David was a little past the top, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys…
Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king; and he had neither groomed his feet, nor trimmed his beard…
For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and…
He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues, or in the…
Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

translations.web: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
translations.bsb: The first to state his case seems right until another comes and cross-examines him.
translations.kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth
translations.asv: He that pleadeth his cause first seemeth just; But his neighbor cometh and searcheth him out.
